name: Southern stream clearing
slug: A streamside clearing south of Langdale Stronghold, chosen for Gerk's doorway practice.
description: A clearing south of Langdale Stronghold, beside a stream, found earlier while looking for hobgoblins. Old buildings or other signs of civilization were there, and bees are nearby.

log.summary: Sylan chooses this clearing for Gerk's doorway practice and explicitly avoids the nearby bees. The practice is also described as starting from the Langdale forest outskirts, out of view of the red-flag runes.
notes: A clearing south of Langdale Stronghold, by a stream, found earlier while looking for hobgoblins. Old buildings or other signs of civilization were there. Sylan chooses it for Gerk's doorway practice and explicitly avoids the nearby bees. The practice is also described as starting from the Langdale forest outskirts, out of view of the red-flag runes.

log.summary: The party treats the clearing as their normal spot, secret spot, and door-testing grounds. Ord and Sylan use it again so the lantern flash stays away from the keep. Gerk watches from the shade there, while Dana only observes from the stronghold tower. When Sylan grabs the staff, the black beacon rises from that treeline. The DM places the end of this scene on the outskirts of Trigash Forest.
